name: JustinGPT
summary: A ChatGPT-style living resume that answers questions about my career.
problem: Static resumes can't answer follow-up questions or show how I actually think.
architecture: Two-step pipeline: a structured JSON classifier routes each question, then a grounded answer prompt streams the response
Layered prompt-injection defenses: preflight heuristics, nonce-tagged delimiters, a canary token and least-context selection
Eval-driven prompt iteration with deterministic graders and an LLM-as-judge
